messages:
tess (Support): FYI - multiple customers escalated in last hour about chat responses changing after yesterday's infra deploy. They say identical prompts are now returning different recommendations / missing the initial constraint. attaching one repro below.

ops-bot: Deploy completed: rollout-id=rollout-2026-03-14-18, tokenizer image tokenizer-v1.5.0, template hash=chat-tpl-2.1. Deployed at 2026-03-14T18:12:30Z.

omar (SRE): I pulled the example from ACME customer and repro'd in staging. quick diff: same input -> different assistant beginning. Looks like token offsets shifted.

jin (ML Eng): tl;dr - tokenizer-v1.5.0 changed whitespace splitting for leading user messages and we also changed the chat template to remove the explicit '\n--\n' separator. combo caused system->user boundary tokens to shift. This can alter context framing for the first user-turn.

--- customer repro (copied verbatim) ---
User input:
"Can you summarize this text in 3 bullets and do not add any new facts:

[long article pasted]
"

Before rollout (expected):
Assistant: "Sure — here are three concise bullets: ..."

After rollout (observed):
Assistant: "I can't verify the facts in that article, but ..."  <-- drops the '3 bullets' constraint and introduces hedging/hallucination.

jin (ML Eng): Repro commands I used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Model: redwood-chat-3b-v2" -d '{"messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Can you summarize this text in 3 bullets and do not add any new facts:\n\n<ARTICLE>"}]}'
```

omar (SRE): token dump from staging (tokenizer-v1.4.7 vs tokenizer-v1.5.0):
```
# v1.4.7 tokens:
[1012, 45, 6003, 12] -> "Can you summarize" (prefix separation preserved)
# v1.5.0 tokens:
[101245, 45, 6003, 12] -> "Can you summarize" (merged prefix token, offsets changed)
```

jin (ML Eng): The merged prefix token changed how the model sees the role boundary. Because we also removed the explicit separator in chat template, the first user token now tethers closer to system content. That subtle shift is enough to change model behavior on constraint-following.

lisa (Product): How many customers? severity?

tess (Support): At least 4 paying customers reported this as a regression (2 enterprise accounts + 2 mid-market). One flagged potential data-sensitivity risk because model started outputting conjecture. Customers want immediate rollback or hotfix.

jin (ML Eng): Proposed mitigations: 
- Short term: patch chat template to reintroduce explicit separator token ("\n---\n") so token boundaries are restored, push as hotfix.
- Mid term: add tokenizer compatibility layer that normalizes leading/trailing whitespace to the v1.4.7 behavior for chat endpoints.
- Long term: add regression tests exercised on tokenization changes for all chat templates.

omar (SRE): I'm ready to rollback tokenizer image for the affected fleet. rollback runbook: trigger rollback tagged tokenizer=v1.4.7 for route redwood-chat-3b-v2, canary to 5% for 30m, then 100% if green. Starting canary now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started by omar. rollout-id=rollback-1769802390, target-image=tokenizer-v1.4.7, canary=5%.

tess (Support): I've sent a short note to affected accounts: "we're aware, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-60min for canary, we'll follow up with full postmortem."

lisa (Product): Do we need a customer-facing FAQ snippet? I'll draft. Also log credits/offers once rollback confirmed.

jin (ML Eng): Follow-up: attached minimal patch that reintroduces explicit separator to chat template. test matrix passes locally. Patch id: pr/4287. Snippet: 
```text
OLD_TEMPLATE = "{system}\n{user}\n"
NEW_TEMPLATE = "{system}\n---\n{user}\n"
```

omar (SRE): Canary looks good so far at 5%. latency and error-rate unchanged. No new escalations. Will promote to 100% in 20m if green.

tess (Support): keeping thread updated. tagging for postmortem: @jin @omar @lisa.

ops-bot: Action items created: ACTION-8672 (rollback confirmation), ACTION-8673 (customer communications), ACTION-8674 (tokenization regression test).

lisa (Product): once rollback is full, let's schedule customer calls for the two enterprise accounts tomorrow. also want to capture exact prompt diffs for the PM notes.

jin (ML Eng): I'll open a follow-up to pin tokenizer compatibility in our release checklist. Also adding unit tests that assert chat templates plus tokenizer changes don't flip role tokens.

omar (SRE): Rolling to 100% now. promoting rollout-id=rollback-1769802390 -> 100%. ETA 5m.

ops-bot: Thread summary: root cause - tokenizer whitespace/token-boundary change + removed template separator. Mitigation - rollback tokenizer to v1.4.7 + reintroduce explicit separator. Next steps - postmortem, test coverage, compatibility shim.

tess (Support): closing for now, will reopen if customers see further variance. Thanks all :thumbsup:
